text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian murderers of Israeli soldier Sharon Edri are caught, his body recovered. Hamas cell in Surif village behind 11 killings of Israelis.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu credits Palestinian Authority with helping to find Edri.
- Israeli Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai: We could retake Hebron if needed.
- PM's office: Economic plan must exclude tax hike.
- Ben-Schach family buys seven percent of the shares of Paz company for about $25 million.
- Bank of Israel survey of 609 companies shows further drop in economic activity and in 2nd quarter another drop expected.
- Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat tells the United States: Now it's Israel's turn.
- Immigration Minister: International isolation of Israel has meant a sharp drop in number of immigrants. Numbers from former Soviet Union down by 22 percent in first quarter of 1997.
- Netanyahu expected to call Arafat, to thank him for his part in arresting the killers of soldier Edri.
